How Movies About Tech Turned Dystopian

In 2014, a film about a prickly, arrogant inventor trying to build a “machine that can solve any problem” arrived in theaters. It explored the secretive creation of a powerful technology that enabled a group of military leaders to unilaterally determine the life and death of thousands.
